messages.subject: R-movement packages survey
parts:
Forwarded from email:
Dear R-package developers,

As some of you may know, I am preparing a review on R
movement/biologging packages. One of the elements that I'll be using to
feed the review is this small questionnaire about the use of the
packages https://mablab.org/survey/index.php/759774?lang=en

I am sending this by several lists and Twitter, so I apologize for the
repeated emails if that's the case. If it is not, it would be great if
you could participate (probably not evaluating your own package but
others), and send this to other people that could potentially have used
your or other packages. If you are interested in the results, I'll send
you an email with access to them once they are ready.

Best,

--
Rocío Joo
